chunks.text: Airy high-altitude intro: soft wind-like synth pad, a few sparse elegant piano notes, anticipation, golden hour.
A light playful pulse enters: pizzicato strings and soft finger snaps, sophisticated and witty, as a can is opened and a drink is poured.
Warm strings rise underneath the pulse, savouring, building gently.
Tension builds on a sustained high string note and a soft ticking rhythm, getting more intense, then stops dead on the last beat, leaving a moment of silence.
Huge dreamy slow-motion release: soaring wordless choir pad and lush strings, floating, euphoric, golden, then swelling into a bright shimmering peak.
